mapper.update: UPDATE document_import_task SET document_id = #{documentId}, status = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM document_resource r JOIN document_content c ON c.id = r.content_id WHERE c.document_id = #{documentId} AND c.stage = 0 AND r.status <> 0 ) THEN #{issuesStatus} ELSE #{successStatus} END, issues_json = COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key', r.resource_key, 'status', r.status, 'errorMessage', r.error_message) ORDER BY r.sort_order) FROM document_resource r JOIN document_content c ON c.id = r.content_id WHERE c.document_id = #{documentId} AND c.stage = 0 AND r.status <> 0 ), '[]'::jsonb), source_sha256 = #{sha256}, updated_at = timezone('UTC', now()), finished_at = timezone('UTC', now()) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{processingStatus}

UPDATE document_import_task SET status = #{failedStatus}, issues_json = jsonb_build_object('code', #{code}, 'message', #{message}), updated_at = timezone('UTC', now()), finished_at = timezone('UTC', now()) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{processingStatus}
